subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw add core Control UI save-time MEMORY.md budget enforcement now, and should auto-archive be in scope or left to the broader bounded-memory design?
rationale: Current main already warns and diagnoses bootstrap truncation; the remaining request changes workspace-file editing and memory lifecycle behavior rather than repairing one existing code path.

options.title: Narrow core UI guard
options.body: Add a Control UI budget display and explicit save-time warning or block for bootstrap files, while leaving auto-archive to a separate memory design.

options.title: Fold into bounded memory
options.body: Track hard limits and archive behavior under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42877 and use this issue as the MEMORY.md UI case after direction is confirmed.

options.title: Diagnostics are enough
options.body: Keep current prompt and doctor diagnostics as the supported behavior and close the UI/save-enforcement request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Narrow core UI guard
recommendation.body: Add a Control UI budget display and explicit save-time warning or block for bootstrap files, while leaving auto-archive to a separate memory design.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history across bootstrap truncation handling and the adjacent Agents dashboard/file-editing surface.
